name: vway-kit
description: Claude Code·Codex 를 지원하는 tier 기반 개발 플러그인

interface.longDescription: vway-kit scales process rigor to the risk of a change. $vdev classifies a task as Docs or Dev and runs only that tier's skills, and a commit gate that $vdev-init registers in the project's .codex/hooks.json blocks a commit that skipped the classification or its gates. Branch names, test commands and checks live in one config file, so the same setup ports to any language and repository.
defaultPrompt: Set up vway-kit in this repo with $vdev-init
Classify this change and run its tier with $vdev
